page.layout: One page of text, with a table of consular years in a single column of entries: year numbers in the right column beside the rule lines; short names in the centre column; margin notes on the left side, two in italic.
page.notes: Left margin notes, in italic: "Frifiorum expedition in Saracenos." beside 1269; "Tumultus in Fivelgonia ob sacerdotium Farmsumanu." beside 1270. The year numbers are printed in old-style figures (1267 to 1276) and are set in the right column; the lines are placed as printed in the table, so the year-to-entry alignment is by position only. Numerals 1270 and 1274: printed as "127" with a bullet, and "127+" respectively; read as 1270 and 1274 from context of the sequence. Catchword "Hugo" is set at the right below the last line, not part of the text. The running head is printed as "Vafti Confulares" in the scan; the long s has been normalised to s and the u/v convention applied to the title.
